Results.ReviewText: Received the grill today, opened the sealed box and it’s missing ALL of the assembly parts. Unable to rate everything else if I can’t use it.
Results.Title: Missing Assembly Parts

Results.ReviewText: We love this grill so much. Wished i had purchased this one long ago. Being seniors it is just the perfect size for us. Starts and works top notch. Grills to perfection every time.
Results.Title: Small weber grill

Results.ReviewText: I’m really having trouble not burning everything, there seems to be no low . I like to cook low and slow, there is no low.its a handy little grill though, perfect fir one person in a small space.
Results.Title: Small and convenient but no true low setting

Results.ReviewText: It’s a great product especially for ease of operation and use. We are using this product with or Rv and we use it a lot!
Results.Title: Weber always has great products

Results.ReviewText: Great size, easy to clean, very portable. Only downside is low is still kind of hot.
Results.Title: Our new traveling weber

ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: The BBQ is a good one. It heats up quickly, is easy to clean, and is quite compact.
Results.Title: Q-1200 Review

Results.ReviewText: I recently purchased my third Weber small gas grill --small, but mighty and versatile. They are very portable, easy to operate, easy to clean, yet function extremely well. I have given one as a gift, and use the other two in outside areas at our beach house. Perfect for easy, last minute burgers, steaks, quick grilled chicken, vegetables or fish. The size also makes placement and storage easy. Yet, it's big enough for most grilling needs. Highly recommend.
Results.Title: Love the Mighty Weber Q

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill, compact, easy to light and even heat.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Good results on everything I have bbq'd so far. I like the size for my small deck.
Results.Title: Good results and size

Results.ReviewText: After getting a big Weber for the back yard this spring, I bought this one for the fifth wheel. It is by far the best compact gas grill I’ve owned. It cooks very even and the temperature is easy to control.
Results.Title: Camper grill

Results.ReviewText: Première fois en camping que je peux faire autre chose que des hot dogs et des toasts sur BBQ. Chaleur assez vive pour griller et cuire les burger à point. J’ai fait aussi de la bavette de veau et de bœuf marinée. De belles marques de grilles grâce aux grille en fonte émaillée. Grade bien sa chaleur permettant de cuire des morceaux plus épais. Enfin je vais me permettre de faire des poitrines de poulet sans crainte qu’il manque de cuisson. Je le recommande à tous les amateurs de grillades qui désirent en faire partout durant leur itinéraire de voyage. Assez compact ni trop lourd.
Results.Title: BBQ compact super efficace

Results.ReviewText: I bought this smaller grille a month ago on the recommendation of two brothers, both accomplished grillers, who’ve used theirs for a year or so. They swear by theirs, and I’m appreciating mine, the more I use it ( about 2-3 X a week).This grille replaces a full- size BBQ, and I use a small charcoal grille as well.  It’s well- made, effectively designed and easy to keep clean ( grilles fit easily into kitchen sink). The grille area seems just right for the two of us, but likely to  present challenges when cooking for four or more. I’ve only used one green bottle so far and, as I refill these myself, the grille is proving economical. The side trays provide just enough room for the stuff I need with me when cooking. (I do worry about forgetting to flip them out before lighting the grille, given the easy starting!) Heat regulation could be a bit of a challenge. I tried the grille with a 20 lb tank when I first got it, but it didn’t work as well as with a 1 pounder ( different pressures, maybe?); but I’ll re-visit that. Overall, so far so good- 4 leaning towards 5.
Results.Title: So far, so good!

Results.ReviewText: And I will purchase another WHY? It's the perfect size. And when it worked, it's just awesome.  So why am I buying another? I've  replaced everything on here and still can not burners to fully come on. Never gets past 100. But maybe it's just time to replace. I've had this for years. And I want another.
Results.Title: 3 stars? But I love this grill!

Results.ReviewText: Had a Weber for years, but sold it when we sold our RV and stopped camping. Recently decided we needed an alternative cooking capability for hurricane season. Didn’t consider anything but the Weber. It’s a great grill and pretty easy to clean up.
Results.Title: Great for hurricane season

Results.ReviewText: I've only had the opportunity to use the grill once, so far, but it worked very well. I had it connected to a 20 pound propane tank for the cook. After a preheat, it seared two ribeyes very well. Nice black lines on the steak. Nice and lightweight and folds down nicely to store in our camper without taking up too much space.
Results.Title: Sear Marks on the Ribeyes

Results.ReviewText: Bought for RV use. Convenient and capable, and has become my only gas grill.
Results.Title: Q 1200

Results.ReviewText:
In February my wife passed away. The big grill we had wasn't needed any more.
I gave to my daughter and her family, theirs was SHOT. She suggested I get a 
small camp type grill. Looking on line I saw this Q1200 and thought this would 
work well for a guy like me. Best grill I could have bought. Happy Camper.
Results.Title: HAPPY CAMPER

Results.ReviewText: Love our new Webber Q1200 grill. It is great for four people. We can easily put it in the car and take it on a picnic.
Results.Title: Love our Webber Q1200

Results.ReviewText: We have two Weber grills - one large one and then this small Weber Q grill. We find that the Q grill uses  less propane than the larger grill, and it works great that you can purchase the attachment where you can attach a large propane tank to the grill. (Instead of having to purchase the small tanks). We enjoy the grill and they come in fun colors.
Results.Title: Nice Grill

Results.ReviewText:
We needed something quick for a BBQ at a Forest Campground, but we didn't expect such a useful grill.  We have the 1200 on the deck of our home sitting on a small table and it's perfect...easy to clean, easy to use and fits our pace perfectly.  One caution that a neighbor had done, and I'm sure if reading the documents, this wouldn't have happened...she folded the two "tables" into the unit and forget, then started the fire...!
I love cheeseburgers and cooking anything on the 1200 is easy!
Would I recommend this...YES...!
Results.Title: Perfect For Small Areas

Results.ReviewText: Perfect size grill, bought it to keep at my girlfriend’s house. I love it more than the large scale bbq at my house.
Results.Title: Perfect steak every time

Results.ReviewText: Great little barbecue for camping. Easy to assemble, compact, lights up every time.
Results.Title: Camping barbecue

Results.ReviewText: Just like my other Weber grills, I am pleased with my purchase. The grill works perfectly as our camping grill, heats evenly, doesn’t flame up and has a great build quality.
Results.Title: Worth the price?

Results.ReviewText: I had the 1200 first and gave it to my son. It was great but I needed a little bigger barbecue. I bought the 2000 w/stand from Costco and use it for the RV and love it. Can’t beat a Weber!!
Results.Title: Best barbecue on the market.

Results.ReviewText: It cooks much better than my old regular two burner grill.  The q formation of the gas cooker cooks very evenly.  I also like the size.  It fits nicely on any table. Excellent grill.
Results.Title: I’m impressed with the 1200 Weber grill

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill. Meets my needs from convenience to quality grilling.
Results.Title: Love my Weber

Results.ReviewText: Perfect for our RV, love the grill, great size and works great
Results.Title: perfect for our RV

Results.ReviewText:
We are an older couple who enjoy grilling in the warm months.  Because it’s just the two of us we have no need for a traditional large multi-burner grill.  I found the Q1200 on your website and thought it would be perfect so I ordered it.  It has turned out to be a great little grill.  Easy to control heat levels and enough grill space for a couple salmon fillets and a tray of vegetables!  Actually, we had our kids and their families over the other night and was able to grill all the burgers and hotdogs at once.  There were 10 of us in total, so this little grill really earned its keep.

If you are looking for a small easily moved and cleaned grill I highly recommend the Q series grills.  I believe they come in 3 sizes, a bunch of fun colors and are great easy to store.
Results.Title: Great little grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grill for any task! Gets really hot for a nice sear!
Results.Title: Great little grill

Results.ReviewText:
First one was still working perfectly after 20 years, so I left it as a present to the new owner of my old home.
Bought a new home and did my research of available grills. Still no better designed grill for my use. I do most all my cooking for 1-4 people.
Results.Title: So loved, I bought a second one!
